# Branch Performance and Efficiency Standards

This document outlines key operational monitoring and review activities:

*   Investigate teller performance quarterly.
*   Monitor teller performance quarterly.
*   Review customer wait time quarterly.
*   Update the branch efficiency standard.
*   Review branch efficiency for strategy 2026.
